title: Lumen Streets · Living nightscapes
description: Turn real streets into living nightscapes. Explore eight places, shape the lights, and save a night.
aboutBody: Map geometry comes from OpenStreetMap. Lighting, traffic and trains are artistic simulations. Underground lines are hidden unless enabled.
aboutScope: Choose a city, shape the light, and save a wallpaper or animation.
